# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is Finwise biggest growth problem is that it is losing users even before they start a trial to explore its features, because Users might not be keen to tryout a new SaaS by signing up for a paid trial without knowing its benefits.

_Working notes: I think FinWise's biggest problem is it is not delivering value that is either not worth paying.
It could be a case of more price than value or it could be that paying customers have other alternatives that could either be cheaper or a better experience. Evidence: I think this because I see only 2% users chose to remain paying customers.
Later, out of that remaining only 40% of the customers chose to remain by end of the first year.
It shows that customers are not getting the value that is worth remaining paying for.
Also, effort from FineWise is going towards paid acuisitions for more trial sign ups and this does not address the situation’s root cause. Against the data: The specific data point that users who are visiting the website is not discovering enough value to even start with a trial_
